lessons.title: A conserved transfer — demonstration
lessons.goal: See how a transfer changes balances while conserving the total.
lessons.coverage: Self-contained fictional demonstration; replace for production.

scenes.headline: One total, two accounts
scenes.narration: These two accounts hold a total of one hundred fifty units.

scenes.headline: Follow the quantity
scenes.narration: Ten units move from the left account to the right.

scenes.headline: The total is conserved
scenes.narration: The balances change, while the total stays the same.
